vocabulary.meaning: a set of rules about what clothes people should wear
examples: The company introduced a more relaxed dress code.
Employees disagreed about whether the dress code was necessary.

vocabulary.meaning: clothes suitable for professional or ceremonial situations
examples: Formal attire is expected at some business events.
He wore formal attire to the interview.
The office allows casual clothes on Fridays.
Her outfit was comfortable but still appropriate for a casual workplace.

vocabulary.meaning: the way someone looks when dressed suitably for work
examples: A professional appearance can affect first impressions.
The company gives new employees guidance on professional appearance.
Jeans may be appropriate in some workplaces but not others.
Choose clothing that is appropriate for the event.

vocabulary.meaning: a standard set of clothes worn by members of an organisation
examples: Staff members must wear a uniform.
A uniform can make employees easy to identify.
